ch.h:
I wonder what our relationships is

Whatever it is, it sure is a bliss.

Seriousness is what I lack says he

Coffee is what he prefers rather than tea.

How serious I am, now that I know

Carefree I look, is what I like to show

Demented for me is all he likes to be

A true friend, is what he wants me to see

He thinks he know me, now that is true

I don’t know myself, neither how to brew

Knowing him all, now has me realized

These figures have all, had me rectified

Giving is all that he knows how to bake

Tired I am, teaching him how to take

Trying to cross my feelings for him to bear

Keep trying is not what’s gonna work here

My interests to him are just a vacancy

Literature and coffee is all he fancy

Disappointment is all I guess I can give him

Same pages are what we can’t be written in

Strong I may look and weak he may seem

Though my strength’s not enough to break his beam

I wonder how we got to and through this fizz

Whatever it was, I’m glad it’s still a bliss
